grades.quote: Complex atomic memory operations on a single memory word or doubleword are performed with the load-reserved (LR) and store-conditional (SC) instructions.
grades.reason: Describes the RISC-V LR/SC atomic instructions, which could be used to build a lock. The encoding table includes an 'ordering' (aq/rl) field. The text never says whether atomic acquisition alone orders accesses in a critical section or whether barriers are still needed, so it gives only limited background.
